title: P.R.I.D.E. Educational Training
tagline: Cultural Competency Grounded in Ventura County Lived Experience
audience: Educators, medical staff, youth-serving organizations, parents & corporate teams
location: On-site at DCVC Community Resource Center or at organizational campus
summary: Parents & Professionals' Responsibility for Inclusion, Diversity, and Equity — intensive cultural competency curriculum developed with Ventura County Behavioral Health.
description: This 4-hour P.R.I.D.E. curriculum equips organizations with the knowledge, language, and cultural competency needed to serve LGBTQ+ individuals with dignity. Research shows that having even one affirming adult reduces suicide risk in LGBTQ+ youth by more than 40%.
learningObjectives: Understand modern LGBTQ+ terminology, pronouns, and evolving identity nuances.
Examine local Ventura County public health data and youth mental health statistics.
Identify systemic healthcare, housing, and educational barriers facing queer and trans residents.
Implement trauma-informed, affirming communication and intake practices in your organization.
Review California legal rights, non-discrimination protections, and mandatory workplace standards.
materials: Ventura County LGBTQ+ Resource Referral Directory
Certificate of Completion (Eligible for CEU documentation)
